text: Die on the exhale, be reborn on the inhale. Turn your breathing into a practice of letting go and renewal. Master this pranayama in two stages. The first stage - with each exhale, feel how the boundaries of your body melt, and you become one with the space around you. Complete dissolution in space. And with each inhale, imagine how from this space you assemble your body anew, fresh and renewed. The second stage - bring in time. Feel each exhale as a little death, fully letting go of yourself and your past. At the moment of retention, when the breath changes direction, feel yourself as eternity. Then perceive the inhale as the rebirth from this eternity of a new self and a new reality. This practice carries a most interesting mystical experience - your form is not fixed, but represents a fluid, constantly re-created dance of energy.
